title: HEC EHSAAS Need-Based Undergraduate Scholarship
description: The Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship is a flagship initiative of the Government of Pakistan. It is designed to ensure that no student is deprived of higher education due to financial constraints. It is the largest need-based scholarship program in the history of Pakistan, targeting students from low-income families. There is no spacefic monthly income.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Must be enrolled in any public sector university.
2. Must belong to a low-income family (monthly income below PKR 45,000).
3. Must not be availing any other scholarship.
4. Students on self-finance or evening programs are ineligible.
applicationProcess:
1. Register on the HEC Online Portal.
2. Fill out the Ehsaas Scholarship application form.
3. Submit required documents online.
4. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (ISAC).
5. Final approval by the HEC Steering Committee.
requiredDocuments: CNIC/B-Form, Father/Guardian CNIC, Salary Slips or Income Certificate, Utility Bills (last 6 months), Rent Agreement (if applicable), Fee receipts, Academic Transcripts.
benefits:
1. 100% Tuition Fee Coverage.
2. Annual living stipend of PKR 40,000.
3. Continuous funding for 4-5 years depending on the degree program.

title: PEEF Special Quota & Master Scholarship
description: PEEF provides opportunities to talented but needy students of Punjab. The scholarship creates a pool of talented youth who can contribute to the economic and social development of Pakistan.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Domicile of Punjab.
2. Secured at least 60% marks in the last degree examination.
3. Monthly family income not exceeding PKR 60,000.
4. Fulfill the specific quota criteria (Orphan, Minorities, Disabled, etc.).
applicationProcess:
1. Obtain the PEEF application form from the university's financial aid office or PEEF website.
2. Fill and attest the form from the Head of the Institution.
3. Submit the form directly to the university's focal person.
4. Final selection is done based on a merit list prepared by PEEF.
requiredDocuments: Domicile Certificate, Income Certificate, Attested Academic Result Cards, CNIC of Applicant and Guardian, Death Certificate (for Orphans), Disability Certificate (if applicable).
benefits:
1. Monthly financial grant.
2. Covers tuition fees partially or fully depending on the university category.
3. Hostel accommodation support for boarding students.

title: National Endowment Scholarships for Talent (NEST)
description: NEST provides scholarships to deserving students in the fields of Nursing and Arts & Culture, aiming to promote education in underrepresented sectors and uplift marginalized communities.Its ok.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Must be a Pakistani citizen.
2. Enrolled in a recognized Nursing or Arts institution.
3. Demonstrated financial need.
4. Maintain a satisfactory academic record.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply through the respective institution's financial aid office.
2. Institution forwards the shortlisted applications to NEST.
3. NEST conducts a financial verification.
4. Award letters are issued to selected students.
requiredDocuments: Admission Offer Letter, CNIC, Family Income Proof, Academic Certificates, Two Recommendation Letters.
benefits:
1. Tuition Fee support.
2. Uniform and Book Allowance (for Nursing).
3. Living allowance (stipend) based on specific category needs.

title: HEC Overseas Scholarships for PhD
description: Aimed at producing high-quality PhD scholars to meet the faculty needs of Pakistani universities. It funds scholars to pursue doctoral studies in top-ranked global universities.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Pakistani/AJK nationals.
2. Minimum 18 years of education (MS/MPhil) with a strong academic background.
3. No 3rd division in the entire academic career.
4. Must pass the HEC Aptitude Test (HAT) with required score.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply online via HEC portal.
2. Take the HAT exam.
3. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed by a panel of foreign experts.
4. Placement in foreign universities according to HEC partnerships.
requiredDocuments: Attested Degrees/Transcripts by HEC, HAT Score Card, Research Proposal, NOC from Employer (if employed), Valid Passport.
benefits:
1. Return Airfare.
2. Full Tuition Fee.
3. Monthly living allowance.
4. Health Insurance.
5. Settlement allowance.

title: Fulbright Scholarship Program
description: The flagship international educational exchange program sponsored by the U.S. government. It is highly competitive and covers all expenses for Master's and PhD studies in the USA.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Pakistani citizen residing in Pakistan.
2. Strong academic background (16 years of education for Masters, 18 for PhD).
3. Valid GRE General Score (Minimum 145 Verbal, 145 Quant).
4. All disciplines eligible except clinical medicine.
applicationProcess:
1. Submit an online application with GRE scores.
2. Include 3 letters of recommendation and a personal statement.
3. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview in Islamabad.
4. Selected candidates take TOEFL and are placed in US universities by IIE.
requiredDocuments: GRE Score Report, Academic Transcripts/Degrees, Personal Statement, Study Objective, 3 Reference Letters, Resume.
benefits:
1. Full Tuition.
2. Required Textbooks.
3. Airfare.
4. Living Stipend.
5. Health Insurance.
6. Visa Process Assistance.

title: Chevening Scholarships
description: Offers fully-funded Master’s degrees in the UK for individuals with demonstrable leadership potential who also have strong academic backgrounds.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Citizen of an eligible country (Pakistan included).
2. Return to home country for at least 2 years after award ends.
3. An undergraduate degree that meets UK entry requirements.
4. At least 2 years (2,800 hours) of work experience.
applicationProcess:
1. Submit an online application via the Chevening portal.
2. Answer four essay questions (Leadership, Networking, Study in UK, Career Plan).
3. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview at the British High Commission.
4. Receive unconditional offer from a UK university.
requiredDocuments: Two References, Valid Passport/ID, University Transcripts/Certificates, Three UK Master's Course Choices.
benefits:
1. University Tuition Fees.
2. Monthly Stipend.
3. Travel costs to and from the UK.
4. Arrival allowance.
5. Homeward departure allowance.
6. Cost of one visa application.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees
description: Prestigious, integrated, international study programs, jointly delivered by an international consortium of higher education institutions in Europe.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Open to students globally.
2. Must have a Bachelor's degree or be in the last year of bachelor studies.
3. Strong academic record and motivation.
4. Proof of English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL).
applicationProcess:
1. Consult the online catalogue of Erasmus Mundus Masters programmes.
2. Choose up to 3 programmes.
3. Apply directly to the consortium offering the specific programme.
4. Selection based on academic merit, motivation, and references.
requiredDocuments: Bachelor's Degree/Transcript, Motivation Letter, CV (Europass format), Recommendation Letters, Proof of English Proficiency, Copy of Passport.
benefits:
1. Full Tuition and participation costs.
2. Travel and installation contribution (up to €3,000/year).
3. Monthly subsistence allowance (€1,000/month).
4. Full insurance coverage.

title: Australia Awards Scholarships
description: Long-term awards administered by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade. They aim to contribute to the development needs of Australia's partner countries.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Citizen of a participating country.
2. Minimum of 2 years relevant work experience.
3. Meet university English language requirements (IELTS 6.5).
4. Commitment to return to Pakistan and contribute to development.
applicationProcess:
1. Check the country-specific profile for Pakistan.
2. Apply online through the OASIS portal.
3. Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview and writing test.
4. Final selection and university placement.
requiredDocuments: Notarized copies of Degree/Transcripts, Birth Certificate/Passport, IELTS/TOEFL Score, CV, Employer endorsement (if applicable).
benefits:
1. Full Tuition Fees.
2. Return Air Travel.
3. Establishment Allowance (A$5,000).
4. Contribution to Living Expenses (CLE).
5. Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC).
6. Pre-course English support (if needed).

title: DAAD Scholarships for Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
description: Offers foreign graduates from development and newly industrialized countries from all disciplines the chance to take a postgraduate or Master's degree at a state-recognized German university.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Works either for a public authority or a state or private company in a developing country.
2. Bachelor’s degree in a related subject.
3. At least 2 years of professional experience.
4. Academic degrees should normally not be more than 6 years old.
applicationProcess:
1. Find the EPOS course list.
2. Send complete application directly to the respective university (not DAAD).
3. University selection committee shortlists candidates.
4. Final approval by DAAD.
requiredDocuments: DAAD Application Form, Hand-signed CV (Europass), Motivation Letter, Letter of Recommendation from employer, Transcripts/Degrees, Language Certificate.
benefits:
1. Monthly payments of 934 euros for graduates or 1,200 euros for doctoral candidates.
2. Payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover.
3. Travel allowance.
4. Initial study allowance.

title: MEXT Scholarship (Embassy Recommendation)
description: Fully funded scholarship by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science, and Technology (MEXT) for international students who wish to study in graduate courses at Japanese universities as Research Students.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Pakistani Nationals.
2. Under 35 years of age (for Masters/PhD).
3. Academic excellence (generally 70%+ marks).
4. Willingness to learn the Japanese language and culture.
applicationProcess:
1. Submit application to the Japanese Embassy/Consulate in Pakistan.
2. Pass the initial screening (Document review).
3. Pass the written examination (English/Japanese/Math).
4. Pass the interview.
5. Obtain a Letter of Acceptance from a Japanese University.
requiredDocuments: MEXT Application Form, Field of Study and Research Plan, Academic Transcripts, Graduation Certificate, Recommendation Letter from Dean/Professor, Medical Certificate.
benefits:
1. Allowance: 143,000 JPY to 145,000 JPY per month.
2. Education Fees: Fees for the entrance examination, matriculation, and tuition at universities will be exempted.
3. Traveling Expenses (Round Trip).

title: Turkiye Burslari Scholarships
description: A government-funded, competitive scholarship program, awarded to outstanding students and researchers to pursue full-time or short-term programs at top universities in Turkey.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Minimum Academic Criteria: 70% for Undergrad, 75% for Graduate, 90% for Medicine/Dentistry/Pharmacy.
2. Age Limit: Under 21 for UG, 30 for Master, 35 for PhD.
3. Not currently enrolled in a Turkish University at the level you are applying for.
applicationProcess:
1. Create an account on the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS).
2. Upload all required documents and fill out the forms (Education, Experience, Motivation).
3. List university preferences.
4. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed in their home country (or online).
requiredDocuments: Valid ID/Passport, Recent Photo, National Exam Scores (if any), Diploma/Transcripts, International Exam Scores (GRE/GMAT/SAT if required by chosen uni), Language Test Scores, Research Proposal (for PhD).
benefits:
1. University and Program Placement.
2. Monthly Stipend.
3. Tuition Fee Coverage.
4. 1-Year Turkish Language Course.
5. Accommodation.
6. Health Insurance.
7. One-off Flight Ticket.

title: Stipendium Hungaricum
description: Based on bilateral educational cooperation agreements, offering thousands of international students the opportunity to study in Hungary. Highly popular in Pakistan.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Nominated by the Sending Partner (HEC for Pakistan).
2. Meet the academic and language requirements of the host university.
3. Medically fit.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply through the Tempus Public Foundation portal.
2. Apply simultaneously through the HEC Pakistan portal (mandatory for Pakistani applicants).
3. Take the HEC HAT test.
4. Nominated candidates are evaluated by Hungarian Universities (interviews/tests).
requiredDocuments: Online Application Form, Motivation Letter, Proof of Language Proficiency, School Certificates/Transcripts, Medical Certificate, Copy of Passport.
benefits:
1. Tuition-free education.
2. Monthly stipend (HUF 43,700 for UG/Masters; HUF 140,000-180,000 for PhD).
3. Accommodation contribution (HUF 40,000/month).
4. Medical insurance.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
description: Aimed to promote mutual understanding and exchanges in politics, economy, culture, education, and trade between China and other countries. HEC acts as the nominating agency in Pakistan for bilateral programs.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Non-Chinese citizens in good health.
2. High school graduate under 25 for Bachelors; Bachelor’s degree under 35 for Masters; Master’s degree under 40 for PhD.
3. Meet language requirements (HSK for Chinese-taught, IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught).
applicationProcess:
1. Obtain an Acceptance Letter from a Chinese University (optional but highly recommended).
2. Apply on the CSC portal (Category A through HEC, Category B directly to universities).
3. Submit physical application documents if required.
4. Final approval by CSC.
requiredDocuments: CSC Application Form, Highest Diploma (notarized), Academic Transcripts, Study Plan/Research Proposal, 2 Recommendation Letters, Foreigner Physical Examination Form, Non-criminal Record Report.
benefits:
1. Tuition waiver.
2. Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy.
3. Stipend (CNY 2,500/mo for UG, CNY 3,000 for Masters, CNY 3,500 for PhD).
4. Comprehensive Medical Insurance.

title: Commonwealth Scholarships
description: Aimed at students from developing Commonwealth countries who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK. Designed to support sustainable development.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Citizen of or granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country.
2. First degree of at least upper second class (2:1) honours standard.
3. Unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply to the Nominating Agency (HEC for Pakistan) and take the HAT test.
2. Apply simultaneously via the CSC online application system.
3. HEC nominates top candidates to the CSC.
4. CSC makes the final selection based on academic merit, impact plan, and study plan.
requiredDocuments: Proof of Citizenship, University Transcripts/Certificates, 2 References, Development Impact Statement, Admissions Offer from a UK University.
benefits:
1. Approved airfare.
2. Approved tuition fees.
3. Stipend (living allowance).
4. Warm clothing allowance.
5. Study travel grant.
6. Family allowances (in specific conditions).

title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
description: Designed to provide international students with opportunities to study at higher educational institutions in Korea to enhance international education exchange and deepen mutual friendship between Korea and participating countries.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Both applicant and parents must not hold Korean citizenship.
2. Must maintain a GPA of at least 2.64/4.0, 2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5, or 3.23/5.0.
3. Good health.
applicationProcess:
1. Choose an application track (Embassy Track or University Track).
2. Submit documents to the Korean Embassy (Embassy Track) or directly to the University (University Track).
3. 1st Round of selection (Embassy/Univ), 2nd Round (NIIED), 3rd Round (University admissions for Embassy track).
4. Final announcement.
requiredDocuments: Application Form, Personal Statement, Study Plan, Recommendation Letters, GKS Applicant Agreement, Personal Medical Assessment, Apostilled/Consular-Confirmed Academic Certificates and Transcripts, Proof of Citizenship.
benefits:
1. Airfare.
2. Settlement Allowance.
3. Monthly Allowance.
4. 1-Year Korean Language Training Fee.
5. Tuition.
6. Medical Insurance.
7. Korean Proficiency Grants (for TOPIK level 5 or 6).

title: Scotland Pakistan Scholarships for Young Women
description: Funded by the Scottish Government, this scheme aims to make higher education more accessible to underprivileged girls across Pakistan, focusing on Education, Agriculture, Food Security, Sustainable Energy, Health Sciences, and STEM fields.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Pakistani female citizens currently residing in Pakistan.
2. Undertaking a 4-year Bachelor’s or 2-year Master’s degree.
3. Must hold a confirmed admission in an HEC recognized university.
4. Demonstrated financial need.
applicationProcess:
1. Create an account on the British Council scholarship portal.
2. Fill out the application form with accurate financial details.
3. Upload supporting documents.
4. Shortlisting based on academic merit and financial background.
requiredDocuments: CNIC/B-Form, University Admission Offer Letter/Fee Challan, Academic Transcripts, Parents/Guardian Salary Slips, Utility Bills.
benefits:
1. Complete Tuition Fees for the entire degree.
2. Hostel accommodation costs.
3. Travel allowances to and from the university (twice a year).

title: USAID Funded Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship
description: Funded by the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) and implemented by HEC, this scholarship supports financially disadvantaged students to pursue degrees in agriculture, business, engineering, and medicine.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Enrolled in a participating university (partner universities).
2. Must belong to a rural or marginalized area.
3. Assessed financial need.
4. Good academic standing.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply directly to the Financial Aid Office (FAO) of the partner university.
2. Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (ISAC) evaluates applications.
3. HEC Scholarship Management Committee (SMC) gives final approval.
requiredDocuments: Financial Aid Form, Income Certificates, Utility Bills, Academic Degrees, CNIC, Domicile.
benefits:
1. Full Tuition Fee.
2. Boarding & Lodging expenses.
3. Books & Transportation allowance.
4. Incidental charges.

title: Al-Khidmat Foundation Alfalah Scholarship
description: Alfalah Scholarship Scheme is dedicated to supporting bright but needy students across Pakistan, enabling them to continue their education from intermediate to master’s levels.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Minimum 70% marks in matriculation/intermediate.
2. Enrolled in a government or recognized private institute.
3. Orphan students are highly encouraged to apply.
4. Financial hardship proof.
applicationProcess:
1. Download the application form from Al-Khidmat website.
2. Fill the form and get it attested by the Head of Institution.
3. Submit to the nearest Al-Khidmat regional office.
4. Selected candidates undergo a physical verification.
requiredDocuments: Result Cards, CNIC/B-Form, Father/Guardian CNIC, Income Certificate, Death Certificate (for orphans).
benefits:
1. Monthly/Annual stipend distributed through bank accounts.
2. Covers essential academic expenses.

title: Fauji Foundation Educational Stipend
description: Fauji Foundation provides educational stipends to the children of ex-servicemen of the Armed Forces to assist them in acquiring quality education.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Children of retired/deceased armed forces personnel.
2. Unmarried and below specific age limits.
3. Enrolled in recognized educational institutions.
4. Minimum passing marks in previous class.
applicationProcess:
1. Obtain the stipend form from Fauji Foundation offices or website.
2. Fill and attest the form from the school/college principal.
3. Attach discharge book details.
4. Submit before the annual deadline.
requiredDocuments: Discharge Book of Father, CNIC/B-Form, Previous Class Result Card, Institution Attestation.
benefits: 1. Annual stipend ranging from PKR 3,000 to PKR 15,000 depending on the education level.

title: Sindh Endowment Fund Scholarship
description: An initiative by the Education & Literacy Department, Govt of Sindh, providing full tuition coverage to deserving students of Sindh studying in reputed universities across Pakistan.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Must possess Sindh Domicile and PRC.
2. Enrolled in approved disciplines (Business, IT, Engineering, Medicine, etc.).
3. Family income must not exceed the specified threshold.
4. Admission on merit basis.
applicationProcess:
1. Advertisement published in leading newspapers.
2. Download form from SEEF website.
3. Submit application via the university's focal person.
4. Verification and final list generation by SEEF board.
requiredDocuments: Domicile/PRC, Income Certificate, University Admission Letter, Academic Transcripts, CNIC.
benefits: 1. Covers 100% tuition fee directly paid to the university.

title: BEEF Scholarships (Balochistan)
description: BEEF was established to provide scholarships to talented and deserving students holding a Balochistan domicile, promoting higher education in the province.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Local/Domicile of Balochistan.
2. Minimum 60% marks or 2.5 GPA in the last exam.
3. Enrolled as a regular student in an approved institution.
4. Not receiving any other scholarship.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply through the focal person of the respective university/college.
2. Fill out the BEEF Out-of-Province or In-Province scholarship form.
3. Submit with attested documents.
requiredDocuments: Balochistan Domicile, Result Cards, CNIC, Institution Endorsement.
benefits: 1. Annual financial assistance covering educational expenses.

title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Stori Da Pakhtunkhwa
description: A merit-based scholarship awarded to top position holders of BISE boards in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to encourage them to pursue higher education.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Top 20 position holders of all BISE boards in KPK.
2. Must take admission in a recognized public sector university.
3. Maintain good academic standing.
applicationProcess:
1. Selected directly based on board results.
2. Students are notified by the Education Department.
3. Verification of university enrollment is required.
requiredDocuments: Board Gazette Result, University Admission Proof, Domicile, CNIC.
benefits: 1. Monthly stipend of PKR 10,000 for the duration of the degree.

title: NUST Need-Based Scholarship
description: Institutional financial aid provided by NUST to ensure that no talented student drops out due to an inability to pay tuition fees.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Admitted to NUST on merit.
2. Verified financial constraint.
3. Maintain a minimum GPA requirement.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply online during the NUST admission process by selecting the Need-Based Scholarship option.
2. Submit the NFA (NUST Financial Aid) form.
3. Interview by the NUST Financial Aid Committee.
requiredDocuments: NFA Form, Income Tax Returns, Bank Statements, Utility Bills, Salary Slips.
benefits:
1. Partial to 100% Tuition Fee waiver.
2. May include a stipend in extreme need cases.

title: LUMS National Outreach Programme (NOP)
description: LUMS NOP extends full financial assistance to exceptional students from underprivileged areas across Pakistan, providing them a chance to study at a premier institution.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. At least 80% marks in Matriculation/O-Levels.
2. Demonstrated financial need.
3. Shortlisted candidates must attend the NOP Summer Coaching Session.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply for NOP during the first year of Intermediate/A-Levels.
2. Attend the Summer Coaching Session at LUMS.
3. Take the LUMS Admission Test (LMAT) / SAT (fee paid by LUMS).
4. Successful candidates are offered full admission.
requiredDocuments: NOP Application, Academic Transcripts, Financial Need Proof.
benefits:
1. 100% Tuition Fee.
2. Registration Fee, Hostel, and Living Stipend.
3. Book Allowance.

title: IBA Karachi Financial Assistance
description: IBA guarantees that no student admitted to its programs will be denied education due to financial constraints. The FA committee assesses needs and grants aid.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Admitted to a full-time regular program at IBA.
2. Inability to pay the fee.
3. Must maintain a CGPA of 2.5 or above.
applicationProcess:
1. Submit the Financial Assistance form online after clearing the entry test.
2. Physical verification of residence may be conducted.
3. Interview by the FA Committee.
requiredDocuments: FA Form, Income Proof, Utility Bills, Bank Statements, Rental Agreement.
benefits: 1. From 25% up to 100% Tuition Fee coverage based on assessed need.

title: Alfalah Scholarship Scheme
description: Provides financial support to talented and deserving students of Pakistan, encouraging them to pursue higher education.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Minimum 70% marks (60% for DAE/Arts).
2. Enrolled in a recognized institution.
3. Financial inability to continue studies.
applicationProcess:
1. Download the application from the website.
2. Submit it to the regional Alfalah office with attested documents.
3. Subject to verification and interview.
requiredDocuments: Attested Copies of Result Cards, CNIC/B-Form, Passport Size Photos, Income Proof.
benefits: 1. Monthly/Annual stipend to cover academic expenses.

title: Karwan-e-Ilm Foundation Scholarship
description: Focuses on finding brilliant but extremely poor students from remote areas of Pakistan and providing them with full financial support.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Must have secured top positions (75%+ marks).
2. Orphaned or extremely needy students.
3. Studying in Government institutions.
applicationProcess:
1. Contact the KIF office or apply online.
2. Submit comprehensive proof of academic excellence and poverty.
3. Field verification by KIF teams.
requiredDocuments: Academic Certificates, Death Certificate of father (if applicable), Proof of Income.
benefits: 1. Tuition fee, books, hostel fee, and monthly living allowance.

title: Professional Education Foundation (PEF) Scholarship
description: PEF provides interest-free loans and scholarships to needy students pursuing professional degrees (Engineering, Medical, IT, Agriculture) in public universities.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Enrolled in a PEF partner public sector university.
2. Minimum 60% marks.
3. Unaffordable financial conditions.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply through the university’s focal person/Financial Aid Office.
2. PEF verifies the application.
3. Funds are transferred directly to the university.
requiredDocuments: PEF Form, Income Certificate, Academic Transcripts, University Fee Voucher.
benefits: 1. Covers tuition fees (as an interest-free loan or direct grant).

title: Diya Pakistan Scholarship
description: Diya Pakistan offers stipends to financially distressed students who are academically sound. It is one of the easiest and most accessible online scholarship systems in Pakistan.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Enrolled in Matric, Inter, Bachelor, or Master level.
2. Minimum 60% marks.
3. Not receiving scholarships over Rs. 25,000 per year from other sources.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply online via Diya Pakistan Web Portal.
2. Upload scanned copies of required documents.
3. Approval process takes 30-45 days.
requiredDocuments: CNIC/B-Form, Father CNIC, Result Cards, Fee Receipt, Head of Institute Attestation Form.
benefits: 1. Annual stipend ranging from PKR 5,000 to PKR 20,000 depending on the level of study.

title: Pakistan Science Foundation (PSF) Scholarship
description: Under the Science Talent Farming Scheme (STFS), PSF awards scholarships to brilliant students to encourage them towards science education.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Students who have passed Matriculation (Science group) with 60% marks.
2. Enrolled in FSc (Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS).
applicationProcess:
1. Apply via NTS/CTS testing service when the advertisement is published.
2. Pass the written science aptitude test.
3. Interview and presentation.
requiredDocuments: Matric Result Card, Domicile, CNIC/B-Form, Test Fee Challan.
benefits:
1. Monthly stipend of PKR 10,000.
2. Study visits to scientific organizations.

title: OGDCL National Talent Hunt Program (NTHP) at IBA
description: A joint initiative to train and fund students from marginalized areas of Pakistan to study at IBA Karachi.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. HSSC Level I/II students from specific underprivileged districts.
2. High academic merit (70%+ marks).
applicationProcess:
1. Apply online on the NTHP portal.
2. Attend a 2-month orientation program at IBA.
3. Pass the IBA admission test.
requiredDocuments: Academic Transcripts, Domicile, Income Proof.
benefits:
1. 100% Tuition Fee.
2. Free Hostel & Mess.
3. Monthly Stipend.
4. Books & Travel allowance.

title: Pak-USAID Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship
description: Targeted primarily at female students and rural youth pursuing Master’s degrees in specific disciplines.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Admitted in an HEC approved partner university.
2. Demonstrable financial need.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply through the university Financial Aid Office.
2. Review by ISAC.
requiredDocuments: Financial Assessment Form, Income Proof, Utility Bills.
benefits:
1. Full tuition fee.
2. Living stipend, books, and boarding allowance.

title: Shahbaz Sharif Merit Scholarship (SSMS)
description: Foreign scholarships provided to highly talented students of Punjab to study at top 50 QS Ranked Universities globally.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Punjab Domicile.
2. Secured admission in a top 50 QS Ranked University.
3. Maximum age 35 years.
applicationProcess:
1. Secure an unconditional offer from a Top 50 university.
2. Apply to PEEF SSMS.
3. Interview by the SSMS Board.
requiredDocuments: Unconditional Offer Letter, Academic Transcripts, CNIC, Domicile.
benefits:
1. Tuition Fees.
2. Airfare.
3. Living Stipend and Health Insurance.

title: Chief Minister’s Merit Scholarship (CMMS)
description: Similar to SSMS, focusing exclusively on PhD studies in top-ranked global universities for outstanding scholars.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Admission in Top 50 Subject-wise QS Ranked University.
2. Excellent academic record.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply after securing admission.
2. Subject to final approval by the CMMS committee.
requiredDocuments: Admission Letter, Research Proposal, Academic Records.
benefits: 1. Full funding for PhD (Tuition, Stipend, Airfare).

title: Benazir Undergraduate Scholarship Project
description: A continuation and rebranding of the Ehsaas undergraduate program, supporting low-income families registered with BISP.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Enrolled in public sector universities.
2. Family must be registered in the BISP database with a low poverty score.
applicationProcess:
1. Apply via HEC portal.
2. Verification with the BISP database.
requiredDocuments: BISP Registration Proof, CNIC, Income Details.
benefits:
1. Full Tuition Fee.
2. Stipend for living expenses.

title: HEC Indigenous PhD Fellowship Program

applicationProcess:

benefits:

2. Book Allowance.
3. Thesis evaluation charges.

title: King's College London President's International Scholarship
coverage: Partial tuition fee waiver (typically £10,000 for one year of full-time study)
description: The President's International Scholarship at King's College London is designed to attract high-achieving international undergraduate students to undertake degree programs at the university, helping them offset the cost of international tuition fees.
eligibilityCriteria: Must be classified as an international student for fee purposes; must have applied for a full-time undergraduate degree program at King's College London; must demonstrate academic excellence.
applicationProcess: Applicants must submit an online scholarship application form via the King's apply portal after receiving an offer of admission.
requiredDocuments: Academic transcripts, personal statement, proof of English language proficiency, and admission application confirmation.
benefits: Financial contribution towards tuition fees of £10,000 for the first year of undergraduate study.

title: HEC Need Based Scholarship Program
coverage: Full tuition fee waiver plus monthly living stipend
description: The HEC Need Based Scholarship Program aims to extend financial support to academically qualified students from low-income families enrolled in public sector universities across Pakistan. The scholarship bridges the economic divide by covering educational costs so deserving students can pursue higher education without financial distress.
eligibilityCriteria:
1. Must be enrolled in a participating Pakistani public sector university or sub-campus.
2. Must have secured admission strictly on open merit (students on self-finance or self-support schemes are ineligible).
3. Must belong to a financially challenged household evaluated through family income, dependents, and living expenses.
applicationProcess:
1. Obtain the official HEC Need-Based Scholarship application form from the Financial Aid Office (SFAO) of your university or download it from the HEC portal.
2. Complete the application form with true financial details.
3. Submit the form along with supporting proof to the SFAO.
4. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (ISAC).
requiredDocuments:
1. Copies of CNIC/B-Form of applicant and parents/guardian.
2. Salary slips or official income certificate of earning family members.
3. Paid utility bills (electricity, gas, telephone) for the last 3 months.
4. Attested educational certificates and mark sheets.
5. Rental agreement copy (if residing in a rented house).
6. Fee receipts of studying siblings.
benefits:
1. Complete coverage of university tuition fees.
2. Regular monthly stipend to cover lodging, food, books, and transportation.

title: HEC Need-Based Scholarship at University of Okara
provider: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan & University of Okara
coverage: Full tuition fee waiver plus a monthly living stipend
description: The HEC Need-Based Scholarship Program at the University of Okara is designed to provide financial assistance to academically qualified students who are unable to pursue higher education due to financial constraints. It covers tuition fees and provides a living allowance throughout the duration of the degree program.
eligibilityCriteria: Newly admitted full-time undergraduate students at the University of Okara; Demonstrated financial need (gross family income below the prescribed threshold, typically PKR 45,000 per month); Maintenance of satisfactory academic progress.
applicationProcess: Complete the official HEC Need-Based Scholarship application form available through the University of Okara Financial Assistance office or online portal, attach all required supporting financial and educational documents, and submit to the Student Financial Aid Office (SFAO) before the designated deadline.
requiredDocuments: Copy of applicant and parent/guardian CNIC/B-Form, Salary certificate or income proof of family, Recent utility bills (electricity, gas, water, telephone), Educational transcripts and matric/intermediate certificates, Copy of rental agreement (if applicable), Rent or fee receipts.
benefits: Complete tuition fee waiver for the entire degree duration and a monthly stipend to cover educational expenses and books.
